channel.title: Thoughts by Rapar Rubel
channel.description: AI agents, Banglish AI, audience-first content and building with AI — by Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah), AI expert and AI workflow builder in Bangladesh.

item.title: Why I Build AI That Speaks Bangla, Banglish and English
item.dc:creator: Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)
item.description: Most AI tools fail Bangladeshi customers because they expect perfect English. Rapar Rubel explains why he builds AI that understands Banglish, and how.

item.title: What Does an AI Workflow Builder Actually Do for a Small Business?
item.dc:creator: Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)
item.description: What an AI workflow builder does for a small business: real examples, how to pick your first AI workflow, and what not to automate. By Rapar Rubel, Bangladesh.

item.title: Paloan — Why I'm Building My Own Personal AI Agent
item.dc:creator: Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)
item.description: Rapar Rubel on Paloan, the personal AI agent he is building to research audiences, draft Bangla and English content, plan launches and run workflows.

item.title: How I Built MimAI, an AI File Assistant, With Claude Code
item.dc:creator: Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)
item.description: How Rapar Rubel built MimAI, an AI file assistant for Google Drive that understands Bangla, Banglish and English, with Claude Code, and what he learned.

item.title: Content Starts in the Audience's Head — My 5-Step Process
item.dc:creator: Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)
item.description: Rapar Rubel's five-step content process — Listen, Decode, Frame, Create, Test — with real examples from fashion, property, travel and cap brands in Bangladesh.
